يسوع هو الراعي الصالح: يدعو خرافه الخاصة بأسمائها ويُخرجها، وهي تتبعه لأنها تعرف صوته. السارق لا يأتي إلا ليسرق ويُهلك، أما هو فأتى لتكون لنا حياة أفضل. وهو يعرف خرافه كما يعرفه الآب، ويبذل نفسه عنها.

ويقول الأصحاح الرابع من كورنثوس الثانية إن لنا هذا الكنز «في أوانٍ خزفية، ليكون فضل القوة لله لا منّا». نحن «مكتئبين في كل شيء، لكن غير متضايقين»، لأن «التي تُرى وقتية، وأما التي لا تُرى فأبدية». ضعفك لا يوقف الله؛ بل يُظهر قوته.

notes.en: "Earthen vessels": cheap clay jars. The treasure inside matters more than the container.
notes.ar: «أوانٍ خزفية»: جرار رخيصة من الطين. والكنز الذي في داخلها أهمّ من الوعاء.

saints.name_en: The Departure of St. James, Patriarch of Antioch

parts.en: On this day, the Holy Father Abba James, Patriarch of Antioch, departed. Great tribulations befell this father. He was exiled for defending the Orthodox faith. After he remained in exile for a period of time, the people of the city gathered and brought him back. Then the Arians exiled him again and he stayed in exile for seven more years, and then departed in peace.
parts.ar: في مثل هذا اليوم تنيح الآب القديس الأنبا يعقوب بطريرك أنطاكية. وقد لاقي هذا الأب شدائد كثيرة ونفي من أجل الإيمان الأرثوذكسي. وفي المرة الأخيرة نفاه الأريوسيون ومكث في المنفي سبع سنين ثم تنيح بسلام.

parts.en: The blessing of his prayers be with us all. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا. آمين.

parts.en: St James, Patriarch of Antioch, suffered great tribulations and was exiled for defending the Orthodox faith; his people brought him back, but the Arians exiled him again for seven years, and he departed in peace. He teaches patience in persecution.
parts.ar: احتمل الأنبا يعقوب بطريرك أنطاكية ضيقات عظيمة، ونُفي لدفاعه عن الإيمان الأرثوذكسي؛ فأعاده أهل المدينة، ثم نفاه الأريوسيون ثانية سبع سنين وتنيّح بسلام. يعلّمنا الصبر في الاضطهاد.

parts.en: Be patient when you're treated unfairly for the truth.
parts.ar: اصبر حين تُعامل بظلم لأجل الحق.

saints.name_en: The Departure of St. Pelagia, the Penitent

parts.en: On this day also, of the year 176 of the martyrs (460 A.D.), St. Pelagia, the penitent, departed.
parts.ar: وفيه أيضاً من سنة 176 للشهداء (460 م) تنيحت القديسة بيلاجية التائبة.

parts.en: This righteous woman was born in the city of Antioch to pagan parents. Besides a corrupt faith, she had a corrupt manner of life also.
parts.ar: ولدت هذه القديسة بمدينة إنطاكية من إبوين وثنيين وكانت قد إقتنت مع نجاسة المعتقد نجاسة السيرة أيضاً.

parts.en: Once, she met a holy bishop, whose name was Nonnius, of Edessa, who preached and instructed her. She believed in the Lord Christ through him, and confessed to him everything that she had done. He encouraged her not to despair but to repent with a true determination. He baptized her and then received the Holy mysteries. The grace illuminated her heart and she led a penitent life with a firm heart and a pure determination. She exhausted her body with strenuous worship, and asceticism.
parts.ar: وكانت تعيش في إماكن الفجور وجمعت من ذلك مبالغ طائلة. وقابلها مرة أسقف قديس يدعى نونيوس فوعظها بكلام كثير فآمنت علي يديه بالسيد المسيح وإعترفت له بجميع ما صنعت فعمدها وناولها من الأسرار المقدسة، فإستنارت بالنعمة وتقدمت في حياة التوبة بنية خالصة وأتعبت جسدها بالنسك والعبادة.

parts.en: Then she dressed herself in the garb of men and went to Jerusalem where she met St. Alexandros, Patriarch of Jerusalem. She narrated to him her story. He sent her to one of the monasteries nearby Jerusalem. She dwelt there for 40 years worshipping with many prayers and fasts. She was known as the monk Pelagius. Then she lived a solitary life in a cave on Mount of Olives for three years and then departed in peace. No one discovered that she was a woman until it was revealed after her death and they buried her with great veneration.
parts.ar: ثم تزيت بزي الرجال وذهبت الي أورشليم. وتقابلت مع القديس الكسندروس بطريرك أورشليم وعرفته بقصتها فأرسلها الي أحد أديرة الرهبان القريبة من أورشليم فمكثت فيه نحو أربعين سنة عابدة بأصوام وصلوات وعرفت بإسم الراهب بيلاجيوس ثم عاشت في حياة الوحدة داخل مغارة مدة ثلاث سنوات ثم تنيحت بسلام. ولم يكتشف أحد انها إمرأة الا بعد نياحتها ودفنوها بإكرام جزيل.

parts.en: The blessing of her prayers be with us all and glory be to our God forever. Amen
parts.ar: بركة صلواتها فلتكن معنا ولربنا المجد دائماً أبدياً. آمين.

parts.en: St Pelagia of Antioch, of pagan parents, lived a corrupt life until Bishop Nonnus of Edessa preached to her; she believed, confessed all she had done, and he urged her not to despair but to repent truly. Baptized, she received the Holy Mysteries and lived a penitent life with a firm heart. She departed in 460. She teaches that no sin is greater than God's mercy.
parts.ar: وُلدت القديسة بيلاجية في أنطاكية لأبوين وثنيين، وعاشت حياة فاسدة حتى وعظها الأسقف نونوس أسقف الرها؛ فآمنت واعترفت بكل ما فعلت، فشجعها ألا تيأس بل تتوب بعزم صادق. فعمّدها وتناولت من الأسرار المقدسة، وعاشت حياة توبة بقلب ثابت. وتنيّحت سنة 460م. تعلّمنا أنه لا خطية أعظم من رحمة الله.

parts.en: Never despair; repent and begin again.
parts.ar: لا تيأس أبدًا؛ تُب وابدأ من جديد.

coptic.t: ⲁϥⲉⲣⲫⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥϣⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲏⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲡⲉ ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲁⲡ: ⲥⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉϥⲉⲛⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ.

ⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲥⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲕⲉⲥⲁⲣⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲓⲗⲓⲡⲡⲉ ⲛⲁϥϣⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲡⲉ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲙⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϯⲱⲙⲥ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲭⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓ ⲇⲉ ϫⲉ ⲏⲗⲓⲁⲥ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲭⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓ ⲇⲉ ϫⲉ ⲓⲉⲣⲉⲙⲓⲁⲥ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫϯ ⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁⲧⲕ ⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲃⲁⲣⲓⲱⲛⲁ ϫⲉ ⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲁϥϭⲱⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲫⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲧ ⲡⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ϯϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲕ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲓⲉ̀ⲕⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲁⲓⲡⲉⲧⲣⲁ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲙⲉⲛϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϣϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲓⲉ̀ϯ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱϣⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲕⲛⲁⲥⲟⲛϩϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉϥⲥⲟⲛϩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲕⲛⲁⲃⲟⲗϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉϥⲃⲏⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ

ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣⲡⲱⲃϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲥⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: ⲑⲙⲉⲧϭⲁⲥⲓϩⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲁⲥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡϣⲱⲓ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲕ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ. ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲉⲓⲉ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ.

ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ϯϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲙⲉⲛⲣⲉ ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲏⲟⲩ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁⲣⲓⲉⲙⲓ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲛ̀ϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲡⲉⲧⲁϥⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲙⲉⲛⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲧⲫⲱϥ ⲟⲧⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲁⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲁⲓⲥⲉⲧⲡ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁⲣⲓⲫⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲃⲱⲕ ⲉⲛⲁⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲁⲩϭⲟϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϭⲟϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲁⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲁⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ⲁⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲫⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲛ ϫⲉ ⲥⲉⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲗⲱⲓϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ϥⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲕⲉⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲓⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉ ⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲙⲉⲥⲧⲱⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲁⲕⲉⲓⲱⲧ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϫⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲧⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϩⲓ ⲡⲟⲩⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲙⲉⲥⲧⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲓⲛϫⲏ

ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ϯϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲛ̀ϥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲣⲟ ⲉ̀ϯⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉϥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ϭⲟϥⲧⲉⲛ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲉⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϭⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲥⲟⲛⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲣⲟ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲫⲁⲓ ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟⲩⲱⲛ ⲛⲁϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲙⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁϥⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϥⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁϥⲉⲛⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡ ⲇⲉ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩϥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϣⲁϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲁϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲥⲉⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲙⲏ ⲡⲓϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ⲫⲱⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟϥ ϫⲉ ⲥⲉⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲥⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲧⲁⲓⲡⲁⲣⲟⲓⲙⲓⲁ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲉⲙⲓ ϫⲉ ⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲟⲛ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ϯϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲥⲃⲉ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲓ̀ ϧⲁϫⲱⲓ ϩⲁⲛⲥⲟⲛⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϩⲁⲛⲣⲉϥϭⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲛϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲥⲃⲉ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϭⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲏⲗ ⲁⲣⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲧ̀ⲉϥϭⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϣⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲱⲛϧ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩϩⲟⲩⲟ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲛⲉϥ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲛⲉϥ ϣⲁϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉϥⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲓⲣⲉⲙⲃⲉⲭⲉ ⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲩϥ ⲁⲛ ⲛⲉ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲛϣ ⲉϥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ϣⲁϥⲫⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲛϣ ϩⲟⲗⲙⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁϥϫⲟⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉⲙⲃⲉⲭⲉ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉⲣⲙⲉⲗⲓⲛ ⲛⲁϥ ⲁⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲛⲉϥ ϯⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲧ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ϩⲱ ϯⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϯⲛⲁⲭⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲁⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ϩⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲁⲓⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲁⲛ ⲛⲉ ϩⲱϯ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ ⲉ̀ⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲕⲉⲭⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲟϩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ

items.en: The Commemoration of the Honorable Archangel Michael
The Martyrdom of St. Matthew the Evangelist
The Departure of Abba Demetrius I, the Vinedresser, 12th Patriarch of Alexandria
items.ar: نياحة البابا القديس ديمتريوس الكرام البطريرك الثانى عشر من بطاركة الكرازة المرقسية

readings.en: I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You. You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And fear Him, all you offspring of Israel!
readings.ar: أُخْبِرْ بِٱسْمِكَ إِخْوَتِي. فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ أُسَبِّحُكَ. يَا خَائِفِي ٱلرَّبِّ سَبِّحُوهُ! مَجِّدُوهُ يَا مَعْشَرَ ذُرِّيَّةِ يَعْقُوبَ، وَٱخْشَوْهُ يَا زَرْعَ إِسْرَائِيلَ جَمِيعًا!

readings.en: As Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he arose and followed Him. Now it happened, as Jesus sat at the table in the house, that behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Him and His disciples. And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to His disciples, "Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?" When Jesus heard that, He said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. But go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy and not sacrifice.' For I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
readings.ar: وَفِيمَا يَسُوعُ مُجْتَازٌ مِنْ هُنَاكَ، رَأَى إِنْسَانًا جَالِسًا عِنْدَ مَكَانِ ٱلْجِبَايَةِ، ٱسْمُهُ مَتَّى. فَقَالَ لَهُ: «ٱتْبَعْنِي». فَقَامَ وَتَبِعَهُ. وَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ مُتَّكِئٌ فِي ٱلْبَيْتِ، إِذَا عَشَّارُونَ وَخُطَاةٌ كَثِيرُونَ قَدْ جَاءُوا وَٱتَّكَأُوا مَعَ يَسُوعَ وَتَلَامِيذِهِ. فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ ٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ قَالُوا لِتَلَامِيذِهِ: «لِمَاذَا يَأْكُلُ مُعَلِّمُكُمْ مَعَ ٱلْعَشَّارِينَ وَٱلْخُطَاةِ؟». فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ يَسُوعُ قَالَ لَهُمْ: «لَا يَحْتَاجُ ٱلْأَصِحَّاءُ إِلَى طَبِيبٍ بَلِ ٱلْمَرْضَى. فَٱذْهَبُوا وَتَعَلَّمُوا مَا هُوَ: إِنِّي أُرِيدُ رَحْمَةً لَا ذَبِيحَةً، لِأَنِّي لَمْ آتِ لِأَدْعُوَ أَبْرَارًا بَلْ خُطَاةً إِلَى ٱلتَّوْبَةِ».

readings.en: I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness In the great assembly; Indeed, I do not restrain my lips, O LORD, You Yourself know. I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth From the great assembly.
readings.ar: بَشَّرْتُ بِبِرٍّ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ. هُوَذَا شَفَتَايَ لَمْ أَمْنَعْهُمَا. أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ عَلِمْتَ. لَمْ أَكْتُمْ عَدْلَكَ فِي وَسَطِ قَلْبِي. تَكَلَّمْتُ بِأَمَانَتِكَ وَخَلَاصِكَ. لَمْ أُخْفِ رَحْمَتَكَ وَحَقَّكَ عَنِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ.

readings.en: Then He went out again by the sea; and all the multitude came to Him, and He taught them. As He passed by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he arose and followed Him. Now it happened, as He was dining in Levi's house, that many tax collectors and sinners also sat together with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many, and they followed Him. And when the scribes and Pharisees saw Him eating with the tax collectors and sinners, they said to His disciples, "How is it that He eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?" When Jesus heard it, He said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
readings.ar: ثُمَّ خَرَجَ أَيْضًا إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ. وَأَتَى إِلَيْهِ كُلُّ ٱلْجَمْعِ فَعَلَّمَهُمْ. وَفِيمَا هُوَ مُجْتَازٌ رَأَى لَاوِيَ بْنَ حَلْفَى جَالِسًا عِنْدَ مَكَانِ ٱلْجِبَايَةِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «ٱتْبَعْنِي». فَقَامَ وَتَبِعَهُ. وَفِيمَا هُوَ مُتَّكِئٌ فِي بَيْتِهِ كَانَ كَثِيرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْعَشَّارِينَ وَٱلْخُطَاةِ يَتَّكِئُونَ مَعَ يَسُوعَ وَتَلَامِيذِهِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كَثِيرِينَ وَتَبِعُوهُ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْكَتَبَةُ وَٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ يَأْكُلُ مَعَ ٱلْعَشَّارِينَ وَٱلْخُطَاةِ، قَالُوا لِتَلَامِيذِهِ: «مَا بَالُهُ يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْرَبُ مَعَ ٱلْعَشَّارِينَ وَٱلْخُطَاةِ؟». فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ يَسُوعُ قَالَ لَهُمْ: «لَا يَحْتَاجُ ٱلْأَصِحَّاءُ إِلَى طَبِيبٍ بَلِ ٱلْمَرْضَى. لَمْ آتِ لِأَدْعُوَ أَبْرَارًا بَلْ خُطَاةً إِلَى ٱلتَّوْبَةِ».

readings.en: And He Himself gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers, for the equipping of the saints for the work of ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ, till we all come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ; that we should no longer be children, tossed to and fro and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in the cunning craftiness of deceitful plotting, but, speaking the truth in love, may grow up in all things into Him who is the head--Christ-- from whom the whole body, joined and knit together by what every joint supplies, according to the effective working by which every part does its share, causes growth of the body for the edifying of itself in love. This I say, therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you should no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles walk, in the futility of their mind, having their understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart; who, being past feeling, have given themselves over to lewdness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
readings.ar: وَهُوَ أَعْطَى ٱلْبَعْضَ أَنْ يَكُونُوا رُسُلًا، وَٱلْبَعْضَ أَنْبِيَاءَ، وَٱلْبَعْضَ مُبَشِّرِينَ، وَٱلْبَعْضَ رُعَاةً وَمُعَلِّمِينَ، لِأَجْلِ تَكْمِيلِ ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ لِعَمَلِ ٱلْخِدْمَةِ، لِبُنْيَانِ جَسَدِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، إِلَى أَنْ نَنْتَهِيَ جَمِيعُنَا إِلَى وَحْدَانِيَّةِ ٱلْإِيمَانِ وَمَعْرِفَةِ ٱبْنِ ٱللهِ. إِلَى إِنْسَانٍ كَامِلٍ. إِلَى قِيَاسِ قَامَةِ مِلْءِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. كَيْ لَا نَكُونَ فِي مَا بَعْدُ أَطْفَالًا مُضْطَرِبِينَ وَمَحْمُولِينَ بِكُلِّ رِيحِ تَعْلِيمٍ، بِحِيلَةِ ٱلنَّاسِ، بِمَكْرٍ إِلَى مَكِيدَةِ ٱلضَّلَالِ. بَلْ صَادِقِينَ فِي ٱلْمَحَبَّةِ، نَنْمُو فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَى ذَاكَ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ ٱلرَّأْسُ: ٱلْمَسِيحُ، ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ كُلُّ ٱلْجَسَدِ مُرَكَّبًا مَعًا، وَمُقْتَرِنًا بِمُؤَازَرَةِ كُلِّ مَفْصِلٍ، حَسَبَ عَمَلٍ، عَلَى قِيَاسِ كُلِّ جُزْءٍ، يُحَصِّلُ نُمُوَّ ٱلْجَسَدِ لِبُنْيَانِهِ فِي ٱلْمَحَبَّةِ. فَأَقُولُ هَذَا وَأَشْهَدُ فِي ٱلرَّبِّ: أَنْ لَا تَسْلُكُوا فِي مَا بَعْدُ كَمَا يَسْلُكُ سَائِرُ ٱلْأُمَمِ أَيْضًا بِبُطْلِ ذِهْنِهِمْ، إِذْ هُمْ مُظْلِمُو ٱلْفِكْرِ، وَمُتَجَنِّبُونَ عَنْ حَيَاةِ ٱللهِ لِسَبَبِ ٱلْجَهْلِ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِمْ بِسَبَبِ غِلَاظَةِ قُلُوبِهِمْ. اَلَّذِينَ -إِذْ هُمْ قَدْ فَقَدُوا ٱلْحِسَّ- أَسْلَمُوا نُفُوسَهُمْ لِلدَّعَارَةِ لِيَعْمَلُوا كُلَّ نَجَاسَةٍ فِي ٱلطَّمَعِ.

readings.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to His abundant mercy has begotten us again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an inheritance incorruptible and undefiled and that does not fade away, reserved in heaven for you, who are kept by the power of God through faith for salvation ready to be revealed in the last time. In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved by various trials, that the genuineness of your faith, being much more precious than gold that perishes, though it is tested by fire, may be found to praise, honor, and glory at the revelation of Jesus Christ, whom having not seen you love. Though now you do not see Him, yet believing, you rejoice with joy inexpressible and full of glory, receiving the end of your faith--the salvation of your souls. Of this salvation the prophets have inquired and searched carefully, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you, searching what, or what manner of time, the Spirit of Christ who was in them was indicating when He testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow. To them it was revealed that, not to themselves, but to us they were ministering the things which now have been reported to you through those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven--things which angels desire to look into.
readings.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱللهُ أَبُو رَبِّنَا يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱلَّذِي حَسَبَ رَحْمَتِهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ وَلَدَنَا ثَانِيَةً لِرَجَاءٍ حَيٍّ، بِقِيَامَةِ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ، لِمِيرَاثٍ لَا يَفْنَى وَلَا يَتَدَنَّسُ وَلَا يَضْمَحِلُّ، مَحْفُوظٌ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ لِأَجْلِكُمْ، أَنْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ بِقُوَّةِ ٱللهِ مَحْرُوسُونَ، بِإِيمَانٍ، لِخَلَاصٍ مُسْتَعَدٍّ أَنْ يُعْلَنَ فِي ٱلزَّمَانِ ٱلْأَخِيرِ. ٱلَّذِي بِهِ تَبْتَهِجُونَ، مَعَ أَنَّكُمُ ٱلْآنَ - إِنْ كَانَ يَجِبُ - تُحْزَنُونَ يَسِيرًا بِتَجَارِبَ مُتَنَوِّعَةٍ، لِكَيْ تَكُونَ تَزْكِيَةُ إِيمَانِكُمْ، وَهِيَ أَثْمَنُ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ ٱلْفَانِي، مَعَ أَنَّهُ يُمْتَحَنُ بِٱلنَّارِ، تُوجَدُ لِلْمَدْحِ وَٱلْكَرَامَةِ وَٱلْمَجْدِ عِنْدَ ٱسْتِعْلَانِ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱلَّذِي وَإِنْ لَمْ تَرَوْهُ تُحِبُّونَهُ. ذَلِكَ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَرَوْنَهُ ٱلْآنَ لَكِنْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ، فَتَبْتَهِجُونَ بِفَرَحٍ لَا يُنْطَقُ بِهِ وَمَجِيدٍ، نَائِلِينَ غَايَةَ إِيمَانِكُمْ خَلَاصَ ٱلنُّفُوسِ. ٱلْخَلَاصَ ٱلَّذِي فَتَّشَ وَبَحَثَ عَنْهُ أَنْبِيَاءُ، ٱلَّذِينَ تَنَبَّأُوا عَنِ ٱلنِّعْمَةِ ٱلَّتِي لِأَجْلِكُمْ، بَاحِثِينَ أَيُّ وَقْتٍ أَوْ مَا ٱلْوَقْتُ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ يَدِلُّ عَلَيْهِ رُوحُ ٱلْمَسِيحِ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِمْ، إِذْ سَبَقَ فَشَهِدَ بِٱلْآلَامِ ٱلَّتِي لِلْمَسِيحِ، وَٱلْأَمْجَادِ ٱلَّتِي بَعْدَهَا. ٱلَّذِينَ أُعْلِنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ لَيْسَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ، بَلْ لَنَا كَانُوا يَخْدِمُونَ بِهَذِهِ ٱلْأُمُورِ ٱلَّتِي أُخْبِرْتُمْ بِهَا أَنْتُمُ ٱلْآنَ، بِوَاسِطَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ بَشَّرُوكُمْ فِي ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ. ٱلَّتِي تَشْتَهِي ٱلْمَلَائِكَةُ أَنْ تَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهَا.

readings.en: And through the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. And they were all with one accord in Solomon's Porch. Yet none of the rest dared join them, but the people esteemed them highly. And believers were increasingly added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women, so that they brought the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and couches, that at least the shadow of Peter passing by might fall on some of them. Also a multitude gathered from the surrounding cities to Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all healed. Then the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with indignation, and laid their hands on the apostles and put them in the common prison.
readings.ar: وَجَرَتْ عَلَى أَيْدِي ٱلرُّسُلِ آيَاتٌ وَعَجَائِبُ كَثِيرَةٌ فِي ٱلشَّعْبِ. وَكَانَ ٱلْجَمِيعُ بِنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فِي رِوَاقِ سُلَيْمَانَ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْآخَرُونَ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ يَجْسُرُ أَنْ يَلْتَصِقَ بِهِمْ، لَكِنْ كَانَ ٱلشَّعْبُ يُعَظِّمُهُمْ. وَكَانَ مُؤْمِنُونَ يَنْضَمُّونَ لِلرَّبِّ أَكْثَرَ، جَمَاهِيرُ مِنْ رِجَالٍ وَنِسَاءٍ، حَتَّى إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْمَرْضَى خَارِجًا فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ وَيَضَعُونَهُمْ عَلَى فُرُشٍ وَأَسِرَّةٍ، حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءَ بُطْرُسُ يُخَيِّمُ وَلَوْ ظِلُّهُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ. وَٱجْتَمَعَ جُمْهُورُ ٱلْمُدُنِ ٱلْمُحِيطَةِ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ حَامِلِينَ مَرْضَى وَمُعَذَّبِينَ مِنْ أَرْوَاحٍ نَجِسَةٍ، وَكَانُوا يُبْرَأُونَ جَمِيعُهُمْ. فَقَامَ رَئِيسُ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ وَجَمِيعُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُ، ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ شِيعَةُ ٱلصَّدُّوقِيِّينَ، وَٱمْتَلَأُوا غَيْرَةً، فَأَلْقَوْا أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ وَوَضَعُوهُمْ فِي حَبْسِ ٱلْعَامَّةِ.

readings.en: The Lord gave the word; Great was the company of those who proclaimed it: "Kings of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home divides the spoil.
readings.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يُعْطِي كَلِمَةً. ٱلْمُبَشِّرَاتُ بِهَا جُنْدٌ كَثِيرٌ: «مُلُوكُ جُيُوشٍ يَهْرُبُونَ يَهْرُبُونَ، ٱلْمُلَازِمَةُ ٱلْبَيْتَ تَقْسِمُ ٱلْغَنَائِمَ.

readings.en: After these things He went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he left all, rose up, and followed Him. Then Levi gave Him a great feast in his own house. And there were a great number of tax collectors and others who sat down with them. And their scribes and the Pharisees complained against His disciples, saying, "Why do You eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?" Jesus answered and said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
readings.ar: وَبَعْدَ هَذَا خَرَجَ فَنَظَرَ عَشَّارًا ٱسْمُهُ لَاوِي جَالِسًا عِنْدَ مَكَانِ ٱلْجِبَايَةِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «ٱتْبَعْنِي». فَتَرَكَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَقَامَ وَتَبِعَهُ. وَصَنَعَ لَهُ لَاوِي ضِيَافَةً كَبِيرَةً فِي بَيْتِهِ. وَٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا مُتَّكِئِينَ مَعَهُمْ كَانُوا جَمْعًا كَثِيرًا مِنْ عَشَّارِينَ وَآخَرِينَ. فَتَذَمَّرَ كَتَبَتُهُمْ وَٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ عَلَى تَلَامِيذِهِ قَائِلِينَ: «لِمَاذَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَتَشْرَبُونَ مَعَ عَشَّارِينَ وَخُطَاةٍ؟». فَأَجَابَ يَسُوعُ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «لَا يَحْتَاجُ ٱلْأَصِحَّاءُ إِلَى طَبِيبٍ، بَلِ ٱلْمَرْضَى. لَمْ آتِ لِأَدْعُوَ أَبْرَارًا بَلْ خُطَاةً إِلَى ٱلتَّوْبَةِ».

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (read at the evening prayer service) (Psalm 22:22–23): Here David cries to God in suffering, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?", words fulfilled in Christ's Passion (Christ's suffering and death), and then praises Him in the assembly.
Vespers Gospel (Matthew 9:9–13): Here St Matthew tells of his own calling from the tax office, and how the Lord answers the Pharisees (a strict Jewish religious party) who object to Him eating with sinners.
Matins Psalm (read at the morning prayer service) (Psalm 40:9–10): Here David tells how the Lord lifted him from the pit and put a new song in his mouth, and asks Him to hasten to help him.
Matins Gospel (Mark 2:13–17): Here the Lord Jesus calls Levi the tax collector and answers the scribes (experts who taught the Law of Moses) who object to Him eating with sinners.
Pauline Epistle (a letter written by St Paul) (Ephesians 4:11–19): Here St Paul tells the Christians of Ephesus about the ministries Christ gave for building up His body, and warns them not to live like the Gentiles (people who are not Jewish).
Catholic Epistle (a letter to all churches by James, Peter, John or Jude) (1 Peter 1:3–12): Here St Peter blesses God for the living hope given to the Christians in exile, a salvation the prophets searched for and angels desire to see.
Praxis (the reading from the Acts of the Apostles) (Acts 5:12–18): Here St Luke tells how many signs are done by the apostles, the sick are healed even by Peter's shadow, and the jealous high priest imprisons them.
Liturgy Psalm (read at the Liturgy, the service of Holy Communion) (Psalm 68:11–12): Here David calls on God to arise, praises Him who rides in triumph and ascends on high, and calls the kingdoms of the earth to sing to Him.
Liturgy Gospel (Luke 5:27–32): Here St Luke tells how the Lord Jesus calls the tax collector Levi, who gives a great feast, and answers the Pharisees who complain.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 22: 22–23): هنا يصرخ داود النبيّ إلى الله في الألم: «إلهي، إلهي، لماذا تركتني؟»، وهو كلام تمّ في آلام المسيح، ثمّ يسبّحه في الجماعة.
إنجيل العشية (متى 9: 9–13): هنا يروي القدّيس متّى دعوته هو من مكان الجباية، وكيف أجاب الربّ الفرّيسيّين (جماعة يهوديّة متشدّدة في حفظ الشريعة) المعترضين على أكله مع الخطأة.
مزمور باكر (مزامير 40: 9–10): هنا يروي داود النبيّ كيف أصعده الربّ من الجبّ وجعل في فمه ترنيمة جديدة، ويطلب أن يسرع إلى معونته.
إنجيل باكر (مرقس 2: 13–17): هنا يدعو الربّ يسوع لاوي العشّار (جابي ضرائب لحساب الرومان)، ويجيب الكتبة (علماء شريعة موسى عند اليهود) المعترضين على أكله مع الخطأة.
البولس (رسالة من رسائل القدّيس بولس) (افسس 4: 11–19): هنا يكلّم القدّيس بولس أهل أفسس عن الخدم التي أعطاها المسيح لبنيان جسده، ويحذّرهم من أن يسلكوا كالأمم.
الكاثوليكون (رسالة من رسائل يعقوب أو بطرس أو يوحنا أو يهوذا) (1 بطرس 1: 3–12): هنا يبارك القدّيس بطرس الله على الرجاء الحيّ الممنوح للمسيحيّين المتغرّبين، خلاصًا فتّش عنه الأنبياء وتشتهي الملائكة أن تطّلع عليه.
الإبركسيس (قراءة من سفر أعمال الرسل) (اعمال 5: 12–18): هنا يروي القدّيس لوقا كيف جرت آيات كثيرة على أيدي الرسل، وكان المرضى يُشفون حتّى بظلّ بطرس، فوضعهم رئيس الكهنة الغيور في السجن.
مزمور القداس (مزامير 68: 11–12): هنا يدعو داود النبيّ الله أن يقوم، ويسبّحه الصاعد إلى العلاء بالظفر، ويدعو ممالك الأرض إلى الترنيم له.
إنجيل القداس (لوقا 5: 27–32): هنا يروي القدّيس لوقا كيف دعا الربّ يسوع لاوي العشّار الذي صنع له وليمة كبيرة، وأجاب الفرّيسيّين المتذمّرين.
days.com_en:
Vespers Psalm (read at the evening prayer service) (Psalm 22:22–23): Here David cries to God in suffering, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?", words fulfilled in Christ's Passion (Christ's suffering and death), and then praises Him in the assembly.
Vespers Gospel (Matthew 9:9–13): Here St Matthew tells of his own calling from the tax office, and how the Lord answers the Pharisees (a strict Jewish religious party) who object to Him eating with sinners.
Matins Psalm (read at the morning prayer service) (Psalm 40:9–10): Here David tells how the Lord lifted him from the pit and put a new song in his mouth, and asks Him to hasten to help him.
Matins Gospel (Mark 2:13–17): Here the Lord Jesus calls Levi the tax collector and answers the scribes (experts who taught the Law of Moses) who object to Him eating with sinners.
Pauline Epistle (a letter written by St Paul) (Ephesians 4:11–19): Here St Paul tells the Christians of Ephesus about the ministries Christ gave for building up His body, and warns them not to live like the Gentiles (people who are not Jewish).
Catholic Epistle (a letter to all churches by James, Peter, John or Jude) (1 Peter 1:3–12): Here St Peter blesses God for the living hope given to the Christians in exile, a salvation the prophets searched for and angels desire to see.
Praxis (the reading from the Acts of the Apostles) (Acts 5:12–18): Here St Luke tells how many signs are done by the apostles, the sick are healed even by Peter's shadow, and the jealous high priest imprisons them.
Liturgy Psalm (read at the Liturgy, the service of Holy Communion) (Psalm 68:11–12): Here David calls on God to arise, praises Him who rides in triumph and ascends on high, and calls the kingdoms of the earth to sing to Him.
Liturgy Gospel (Luke 5:27–32): Here St Luke tells how the Lord Jesus calls the tax collector Levi, who gives a great feast, and answers the Pharisees who complain.

Jesus sees a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office and says, "Follow Me." He leaves all, rises and follows Him, and makes Him a great feast with many tax collectors. The scribes and Pharisees complain, "Why do You eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?" Jesus answers, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."

Ephesians 4: Christ gave "some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers, for the equipping of the saints for the work of ministry," "till we all come to the unity of the faith," "speaking the truth in love," no longer walking "in the futility of their mind." Today we remember St Matthew (Levi), the tax collector who became an apostle and evangelist.

Today the Church remembers the martyrdom of St Matthew the Evangelist.

رأى يسوع عشارًا اسمه لاوي جالسًا عند مكان الجباية فقال له: «اتبعني». فترك كل شيء وقام وتبعه، وصنع له وليمة كبيرة مع جمع كثير من العشارين. فتذمر الكتبة والفريسيون: «لماذا تأكلون وتشربون مع عشارين وخطاة؟» فأجاب يسوع: «لا يحتاج الأصحاء إلى طبيب بل المرضى. لم آتِ لأدعو أبرارًا بل خطاة إلى التوبة».

وفي أفسس 4: المسيح «أعطى البعض أن يكونوا رسلًا، والبعض أنبياء، والبعض مبشرين، والبعض رعاة ومعلمين، لأجل تكميل القديسين لعمل الخدمة»، «إلى أن ننتهي جميعنا إلى وحدانية الإيمان»، «صادقين في المحبة»، فلا نسلك «ببطل ذهنهم». ونتذكر اليوم القديس متى (لاوي) العشار الذي صار رسولًا وإنجيليًا.

تتذكر الكنيسة اليوم استشهاد القديس متى الإنجيلي.

notes.en: Matthew 9:9 tells the same call in Matthew's own Gospel.
notes.ar: يروي متى 9: 9 الدعوة نفسها في إنجيل متى.

saints.name_en: The Commemoration of the Honorable Archangel Michael

parts.en: On the twelfth day of each Coptic month the church celebrates, the commemoration of the honorable Michael the Archangel, the head of the Heavenly Hosts. He stands at all times before the throne of the Divine Majesty interceding on behalf of the human race.
parts.ar: تعيد الكنيسة في هذا اليوم من كل شهر قبطى بتذكار رئيس الملائكة الجليل ميخائيل رئيس الأجناد السماوية القائم كل حين أمام كرسي العظمة الالهية يشفع في جنس البشر.

parts.en: The blessing of his holy intercession be with us all. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة شفاعته المقدسة فلتكن معنا. آمين.

parts.en: On this day of every Coptic month the Church commemorates the Archangel Michael, head of the heavenly hosts and intercessor for mankind. It reminds us that the angels pray for us.
parts.ar: في هذا اليوم من كل شهر قبطي تحتفل الكنيسة بتذكار رئيس الملائكة ميخائيل، رئيس الجند السمائي والشفيع في جنس البشر. ويذكّرنا أن الملائكة يصلّون لأجلنا.

parts.en: Ask the Archangel Michael to intercede for you.
parts.ar: اطلب من رئيس الملائكة ميخائيل أن يتشفع فيك.

saints.name_en: The Martyrdom of St. Matthew the Evangelist

parts.en: On this day also, of the year 70 A.D., St. Matthew the Evangelist, was martyred. He was one of the Twelve Disciples and his name was Levi. The name Matthew came from the Hebrew word “Mattathia” which means the gift of God.
parts.ar: وفي مثل هذا اليوم من سنة 70 م إستشهد القديس متي الإنجيلي أحد الاثني عشر رسولاً وكلمة "متي" من الكلمة العبرية "متاثيا" أى عطية الله.

parts.en: This saint was born in Cana of Galilee. He had another name which is “Levi” the son of Alphaeus from the tribe of Levi. He was a tax collector in Capernaum for the benefit of the Roman Occupier. This job was hated by the Jews.
parts.ar: ولد هذا القديس في قانا الجليل وكان له إسم آخر هو "لاوى" بن حلفى من سبط لاوى. وكان يعمل عشاراً أى جابياً للضرائب في كفر ناحوم لحساب المستعمر الروماني وكانت هذه الوظيفة مكروهة لليهود.

parts.en: When the Lord Christ saw him sitting at the tax office in Capernaum called him for the apostolic ministry (Mat. 9:9). After his calling, he made for the Lord Christ and His disciples a great feast and he invited all his fellow tax collectors to hear the words of grace and life to believe through them.
parts.ar: ولما رآه السيد المسيح جالساً عند مكان الجباية فى كفر ناحوم دعاه للخدمة الرسولية (مت 9: 9). وبعد دعوته صنع وليمة عظيمة للرب وتلاميذه دعا فيها زملاءه العشارين ليسمعوا كلمات النعمة والحياة ليؤمنوا بها.

parts.en: He became a disciple for the Lord Christ during His earthly ministry. After the ascension of the Lord and the coming down of the Holy Spirit on him along with the disciples, he preached in the land of Palestine, Tyre and Sidon.
parts.ar: والقديس متى تتلمذ للسيد المسيح مدة خدمته علي الارض. وبعد الصعود وحلول الروح القدس عليه مع التلاميذ كرز في بلاد فلسطين وصور وصيدا.

parts.en: This Saint wrote his Gospel around the year 60 A.D. in Hebrew (Aramaic) to declare to the Jews that Jesus Christ is the awaited Savior, the Messiah. In whom all the prophecies of the Old Testament were fulfilled, and for this reason he quoted many of the verses of the Old Testament that spoke about the Lord Christ.
parts.ar: كتب هذا القديس إنجيله بالعبرية (الأرامية) لليهود حوالي عام 60 م ليعلن لهم أن الرب يسوع المسيح هو المسيا المخلص المنتظر الذي فيه تحققت جميع نبوات العهد القديم، لذلك إقتبس الكثير من آيات العهد القديم التى تتحدث عن السيد المسيح.

parts.en: St. Matthew preached later on in the Arabian countries, Yemen and the southern region of the Arabian peninsula. From there he traveled to Ethiopia. There, he preached the good news of the Gospel and through him the king of Ethiopia’s daughter, Ephigenia believed. She vowed herself to a life of virginity and many of the daughters of the noble families followed her.
parts.ar: كرز القديس متى بعد ذلك في بلاد العرب واليمن وجنوبي الجزيرة العربية ومنها سافر الي الحبشة حيث كرز هناك ببشارة الإنجيل. وهناك آمنت علي يديه أفجانيا إبنة ملك الحبشة ونذرت نفسها للبتولية وإقتفي إثرها كثيرات من بنات العظماء.

parts.en: After the death of the King of Ethiopia, his brother took over the kingdom by force. He wanted to marry St. Ephigenia to establish his kingdom, but she refused. The king summoned St. Matthew the apostle and asked him to convince her with this marriage. Nevertheless, he did not do that but instead he encouraged her on her vow and decision. The king was filled with rage and wanted to slay the saint.
parts.ar: وبعد موت الملك أغتصب أخوه المملكة وأراد أن يتزوج أفجانيا لكي يثبِّت مملكته فرفضت. فإستدعي متي الرسول وطلب منه إقناعها بهذا الزواج فلم يفعل بل ثبتها علي عزمها ونذرها فغضب الملك وأراد قتله.

parts.en: One day while St. Matthew was praying the Divine Liturgy the soldiers of the king took him by surprise and beat him severely until they killed him. Thus he received the crown of martyrdom.
parts.ar: وبينما هو يصلى القداس الإلهي ذات يوم فاجأه جنود الملك بالضرب حتي قتلوه فنال إكليل الشهادة.

parts.en: The believers took his pure body and buried him with great honor and many churches were built after his name.
parts.ar: وأخذ المؤمنون جسده الطاهر ودفنوه بإحترام جزيل وبنيت على إسمه كنائس كثيرة.

parts.en: The blessing of his prayers be with us all. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا. آمين.

parts.en: St Matthew the Evangelist, also called Levi son of Alphaeus, of Levi, born in Cana, was a tax collector in Capernaum for the Romans, a hated job. Christ saw him at the tax office and called him, and he made a great feast for the Lord and His disciples. His name means "gift of God." Martyred in 70. He teaches that Christ calls those others reject.
parts.ar: كان القديس متى الإنجيلي، ويُدعى لاوي بن حلفى من سبط لاوي، مولودًا في قانا الجليل، وعشارًا في كفرناحوم لحساب الرومان، وهي وظيفة مكروهة. فرآه المسيح جالسًا عند مكان الجباية ودعاه، فصنع له وللتلاميذ وليمة عظيمة. ومعنى اسمه «عطية الله». واستشهد سنة 70م. يعلّمنا أن المسيح يدعو من يرفضهم الآخرون.

parts.en: Don't write anyone off; Christ calls everyone.
parts.ar: لا تستبعد أحدًا؛ فالمسيح يدعو الجميع.

saints.name_en: The Departure of Abba Demetrius I, the Vinedresser, 12th Patriarch of Alexandria
saints.name_ar: نياحة البابا القديس ديمتريوس الكرام البطريرك الثانى عشر من بطاركة الكرازة المرقسية

parts.en: On this day also of the year 230 A.D., the pure and celibate father, Anba Demetrius I, the 12th Patriarch of Alexandria, departed.
parts.ar: وفيه أيضاً من سنة 230 م تنيح الاب البتول الطاهر الأنبا ديمتريوس الأول البطريرك الثاني عشر من بطاركة الكرازة المرقسية.

parts.en: This saint was born in the city of Ahnasia. He was an illiterate farmer, and was married. He lived with his wife for 47 years in complete celibacy with all purity and chastity.
parts.ar: وُلد هذا القديس بأهناسيا المدينة (مدينة أثرية وهي إحدي مراكز محافظة بنى سويف) وكان فلاحاً أمياً متزوجاً وقد عاش مع امرأته في بتولية كاملة وفي عفة ونقاوة.

parts.en: When the departure of St. Yulianus (Julian), the 11th Pope, drew near, the angel of the Lord appeared to St. Yulianus in a vision and told him about who would succeed him. He gave him a sign saying, "Tomorrow a man shall come to you having a cluster of grapes, he is the one to succeed you.” When he woke up from his sleep, he told those who were around him about this vision.
parts.ar: ولما قربت نياحة القديس يوليانوس البابا الحادى عشر ظهر له ملاك الرب في رؤيا وأعلمه بمن سيكون بعده وأعطاه علامة بقوله: "غدا سيأتيك رجل ومعه عنقود عنب هو الذي سيخلفك" ولما إنتبه البطريرك من نومه أخبر من حوله بهذه الرؤيا.

parts.en: So it happened on the next day that St. Demetrius found a ripened cluster of grapes that was out of season. He carried it to St. Yulianus, to receive his blessing. The father, the Patriarch, took him by his hand and told those who were present, "This is your Patriarch who will be after me." Then he prayed over him.
parts.ar: وفي الغد دخل القديس ديمتريوس الي البابا البطريرك ومعه عنقود عنب نضج في غير أوانه ليقدمه للبابا لينال بركته.

parts.en: They held him and kept him in the patriarchal residence until Pope Yulianus, departed in peace, whereupon they finished the prayers of ordination and enthroned him as patriarch. He was filled with the heavenly grace, and the Lord enlightened his mind and he learned reading and writing. He studied the church books and their interpretations. Words of grace flew from his mouth when he preached the people.
parts.ar: فأمسكوه رغماً عنه وأبقوه في الدار البطريركية الي ان تنيح البابا يوليانوس بسلام. فاقاموا القديس ديمتريوس بطريركاً وأكملوا الصلوات عليه فأمتلأ من النعمة الالهية وتعلم كل علوم البيعة. وكان يعظ الشعب.

parts.en: He established the reckoning of the Epacts, by which the dates of fasting and feasts were determined on a fixed basis and in a very accurate manner. He appended the Holy Fast to the Passion Week.
parts.ar: وهو الذي وضع قواعد حساب الأبقطي الذي به تستخرج مواعيد الاصوام والأعياد بنظام في غاية الدقة. كذلك هو الذي ضم صوم الأربعين المقدسة الي صوم أسبوع الالام.

parts.en: Pope Demetrius wrote in this respect to the Patriarchs of Jerusalem; of Antioch; of Rome and to others. They all approved, and followed it.
parts.ar: وكتب بذلك الي بطاركة أورشليم وروما وانطاكية فإستحسنوه وعملوا به.

parts.en: God was with Anba Demetrius because of his purity and chastity. God granted him the gift of knowing who was worthy of partaking of the Holy Mysteries from those who were not worthy. He admonished the sinners urging them to repent.
parts.ar: وكان الله مع هذا الأب لبتوليته وأعطاه حكمة حتي أنه كان يميز من يستحق التناول ومن لا يستحق وكان يبكت الخطاة ويحثهم علي التوبة.

parts.en: Because he rebuked the sinners often, and urged them on repentance, some of them murmured saying, "This man is married, and how can he rebuke us?" The Lord Almighty wished to reveal to them the virtue of his celibacy, so the angel of the Lord came to him at night and told him, "O Demetrius, do not seek only your salvation and let others be in a web of doubt and perdition. You must reveal the mystery which is between yourself and your wife to the people so that you might remove the doubt from them."
parts.ar: فتذمر بعضهم وقالوا عليه: " هذا رجل متزوج فكيف يبكتنا؟". فأراد الله إظهار بتوليته فأتاه ملاك الرب قائلا:" لا تطلب خلاصك وحدك وتترك غيرك في شبكة الشك والهلاك. يجب ان تكشف السر الذي بينك وبين زوجتك للشعب حتي يزول عنهم الشك".

parts.en: On the following morning, after he had celebrated the Divine Liturgy, he ordered the people not to leave the church. He took red-hot coal and placed it in his wife's shawl and his pallium, then they went around in the church and their clothes did not burn. The people were amazed at this miracle. He then told them that he and his wife did not know each other as married people till that day. The doubt was removed from the people and they realized the purity of this father and his chastity.
parts.ar: وفي الصباح صلي القداس الالهي وبعد الصلاة أمر الشعب بعدم الخروج من الكنيسة، ونادى على زوجته من بين النساء. ثم أخذ جمراً ووضع بعضا منه في إزار زوجته وبعض آخر في بلينته (أى الشملة الخاصة بالخدمة الكهنوتية) وطافا معا في الكنيسة فلم تحترق ثيابهما فتعجب الشعب من هذه المعجزة ثم عرفهم أنه وزوجته لم يعرفا بعضهما معرفة الزواج الي اليوم وتيقنوا من بتولية هذا الأب وطهارته.

parts.en: During the days of his papacy, he did not stop teaching and confirming the believers in the Orthodox Faith. He grew old and reached the age of 105 years, then departed in peace.
parts.ar: وظل هذا القديس يعلم شعبه ويثبتهم علي الايمان المستقيم حتي شاخ وبلغ من العمر مئة وخمس سنين وتنيح بسلام.

parts.en: The blessings of his prayers be with us all and Glory be to our God forever. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا ولربنا المجد دائماً أبدياً. آمين.

parts.en: Pope Demetrius I the Vinedresser, the 12th Patriarch, an illiterate married farmer from Ahnasia, lived 47 years with his wife in complete purity. An angel told the dying Pope Julian that his successor would come the next day carrying a cluster of grapes. He departed in 230. He teaches that God chooses the humble.
parts.ar: وُلد البابا ديمتريوس الأول الكرام، البطريرك الـ12، في أهناسيا، وكان فلاحًا أميًا متزوجًا، وعاش مع زوجته 47 سنة في بتولية كاملة بكل طهارة وعفة. وظهر ملاك للبابا يوليانوس قبل نياحته وقال له إن رجلًا يأتيه غدًا ومعه عنقود عنب هو الذي يخلفه. وتنيّح سنة 230م. يعلّمنا أن الله يختار المتواضعين.

parts.en: God can use the humble and simple.
parts.ar: الله يستخدم المتواضعين والبسطاء.

items.en: The Departure of Saint Zacharias, the Monk

readings.en: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You. Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, And govern the nations on earth.Selah
readings.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ يَا ٱللهُ. يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ كُلُّهُمْ. تَفْرَحُ وَتَبْتَهِجُ ٱلْأُمَمُ لِأَنَّكَ تَدِينُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ بِٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ، وَأُمَمَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَهْدِيهِمْ. سِلَاهْ.

readings.en: When they had come to Capernaum, those who received the temple tax came to Peter and said, "Does your Teacher not pay the temple tax?" He said, "Yes." And when he had come into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth take customs or taxes, from their sons or from strangers?" Peter said to Him, "From strangers." Jesus said to him, "Then the sons are free. Nevertheless, lest we offend them, go to the sea, cast in a hook, and take the fish that comes up first. And when you have opened its mouth, you will find a piece of money; take that and give it to them for Me and you."
readings.ar: وَلَمَّا جَاءُوا إِلَى كَفْرَنَاحُومَ تَقَدَّمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْخُذُونَ ٱلدِّرْهَمَيْنِ إِلَى بُطْرُسَ وَقَالُوا: «أَمَا يُوفِي مُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱلدِّرْهَمَيْنِ؟». قَالَ: «بَلَى». فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ ٱلْبَيْتَ سَبَقَهُ يَسُوعُ قَائِلًا: «مَاذَا تَظُنُّ يا سِمْعَانُ؟ مِمَّنْ يَأْخُذُ مُلُوكُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجِبَايَةَ أَوِ ٱلْجِزْيَةَ، أَمِنْ بَنِيهِمْ أَمْ مِنَ ٱلْأَجَانِبِ؟». قَالَ لَهُ بُطْرُسُ: «مِنَ ٱلْأَجَانِبِ». قَالَ لَهُ يَسُوعُ: «فَإِذًا ٱلْبَنُونَ أَحْرَارٌ. وَلَكِنْ لِئَلَّا نُعْثِرَهُمُ، ٱذْهَبْ إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ وَأَلْقِ صِنَّارَةً، وَٱلسَّمَكَةُ ٱلَّتِي تَطْلُعُ أَوَّلًا خُذْهَا، وَمَتَى فَتَحْتَ فَاهَا تَجِدْ إِسْتَارًا، فَخُذْهُ وَأَعْطِهِمْ عَنِّي وَعَنْكَ».

readings.en: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches. Because Your lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise You. Thus I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.
readings.ar: إِذَا ذَكَرْتُكَ عَلَى فِرَاشِي، فِي ٱلسُّهْدِ أَلْهَجُ بِكَ، لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ. شَفَتَايَ تُسَبِّحَانِكَ. هَكَذَا أُبَارِكُكَ فِي حَيَاتِي. بِٱسْمِكَ أَرْفَعُ يَدَيَّ.

readings.en: Very early in the morning, on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen. And they said among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?" But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away--for it was very large. And entering the tomb, they saw a young man clothed in a long white robe sitting on the right side; and they were alarmed. But he said to them, "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid Him. But go, tell His disciples--and Peter--that He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him, as He said to you." So they went out quickly and fled from the tomb, for they trembled and were amazed. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
readings.ar: وَبَاكِرًا جِدًّا فِي أَوَّلِ ٱلْأُسْبُوعِ أَتَيْنَ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ إِذْ طَلَعَتِ ٱلشَّمْسُ. وَكُنَّ يَقُلْنَ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ: «مَنْ يُدَحْرِجُ لَنَا ٱلْحَجَرَ عَنْ بَابِ ٱلْقَبْرِ؟». فَتَطَلَّعْنَ وَرَأَيْنَ أَنَّ ٱلْحَجَرَ قَدْ دُحْرِجَ! لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ عَظِيمًا جِدًّا. وَلَمَّا دَخَلْنَ ٱلْقَبْرَ رَأَيْنَ شَابًّا جَالِسًا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ لَابِسًا حُلَّةً بَيْضَاءَ، فَٱنْدَهَشْنَ. فَقَالَ لَهُنَّ: «لَا تَنْدَهِشْنَ! أَنْتُنَّ تَطْلُبْنَ يَسُوعَ ٱلنَّاصِرِيَّ ٱلْمَصْلُوبَ. قَدْ قَامَ! لَيْسَ هُوَ هَهُنَا. هُوَذَا ٱلْمَوْضِعُ ٱلَّذِي وَضَعُوهُ فِيهِ. لَكِنِ ٱذْهَبْنَ وَقُلْنَ لِتَلَامِيذِهِ وَلِبُطْرُسَ: إِنَّهُ يَسْبِقُكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَلِيلِ. هُنَاكَ تَرَوْنَهُ كَمَا قَالَ لَكُمْ». فَخَرَجْنَ سَرِيعًا وَهَرَبْنَ مِنَ ٱلْقَبْرِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرِّعْدَةَ وَٱلْحَيْرَةَ أَخَذَتَاهُنَّ. وَلَمْ يَقُلْنَ لِأَحَدٍ شَيْئًا لِأَنَّهُنَّ كُنَّ خَائِفَاتٍ.

readings.en: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord, and ourselves your bondservants for Jesus' sake. For it is the God who commanded light to shine out of darkness, who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ. But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us. We are hard-pressed on every side, yet not crushed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed-- always carrying about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our body. For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus' sake, that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our mortal flesh. So then death is working in us, but life in you. And since we have the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, "I believed and therefore I spoke," we also believe and therefore speak, knowing that He who raised up the Lord Jesus will also raise us up with Jesus, and will present us with you. For all things are for your sakes, that grace, having spread through the many, may cause thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
readings.ar: فَإِنَّنَا لَسْنَا نَكْرِزُ بِأَنْفُسِنَا، بَلْ بِٱلْمَسِيحِ يَسُوعَ رَبًّا، وَلَكِنْ بِأَنْفُسِنَا عَبِيدًا لَكُمْ مِنْ أَجْلِ يَسُوعَ. لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ ٱلَّذِي قَالَ: «أَنْ يُشْرِقَ نُورٌ مِنْ ظُلْمَةٍ»، هُوَ ٱلَّذِي أَشْرَقَ فِي قُلُوبِنَا، لِإِنَارَةِ مَعْرِفَةِ مَجْدِ ٱللهِ فِي وَجْهِ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. وَلَكِنْ لَنَا هَذَا ٱلْكَنْزُ فِي أَوَانٍ خَزَفِيَّةٍ، لِيَكُونَ فَضْلُ ٱلْقُوَّةِ لِلهِ لَا مِنَّا. مُكْتَئِبِينَ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، لَكِنْ غَيْرَ مُتَضَايِقِينَ. مُتَحَيِّرِينَ، لَكِنْ غَيْرَ يَائِسِينَ. مُضْطَهَدِينَ، لَكِنْ غَيْرَ مَتْرُوكِينَ. مَطْرُوحِينَ، لَكِنْ غَيْرَ هَالِكِينَ. حَامِلِينَ فِي ٱلْجَسَدِ كُلَّ حِينٍ إِمَاتَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ يَسُوعَ، لِكَيْ تُظْهَرَ حَيَاةُ يَسُوعَ أَيْضًا فِي جَسَدِنَا. لِأَنَّنَا نَحْنُ ٱلْأَحْيَاءَ نُسَلَّمُ دَائِمًا لِلْمَوْتِ مِنْ أَجْلِ يَسُوعَ، لِكَيْ تَظْهَرَ حَيَاةُ يَسُوعَ أَيْضًا فِي جَسَدِنَا ٱلْمَائِتِ. إِذًا ٱلْمَوْتُ يَعْمَلُ فِينَا، وَلَكِنِ ٱلْحَيَاةُ فِيكُمْ. فَإِذْ لَنَا رُوحُ ٱلْإِيمَانِ عَيْنُهُ، حَسَبَ ٱلْمَكْتُوبِ: «آمَنْتُ لِذَلِكَ تَكَلَّمْتُ»، نَحْنُ أَيْضًا نُؤْمِنُ وَلِذَلِكَ نَتَكَلَّمُ أَيْضًا. عَالِمِينَ أَنَّ ٱلَّذِي أَقَامَ ٱلرَّبَّ يَسُوعَ سَيُقِيمُنَا نَحْنُ أَيْضًا بِيَسُوعَ، وَيُحْضِرُنَا مَعَكُمْ. لِأَنَّ جَمِيعَ ٱلْأَشْيَاءِ هِيَ مِنْ أَجْلِكُمْ، لِكَيْ تَكُونَ ٱلنِّعْمَةُ وَهِيَ قَدْ كَثُرَتْ بِٱلْأَكْثَرِينَ، تَزِيدُ ٱلشُّكْرَ لِمَجْدِ ٱللهِ.

readings.en: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by good conduct that his works are done in the meekness of wisdom. But if you have bitter envy and self-seeking in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth. This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, demonic. For where envy and self-seeking exist, confusion and every evil thing are there. But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy. Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace. Where do wars and fights come from among you? Do they not come from your desires for pleasure that war in your members? You lust and do not have. You murder and covet and cannot obtain. You fight and war. Yet you do not have because you do not ask. You ask and do not receive, because you ask amiss, that you may spend it on your pleasures. Adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God. Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit who dwells in us yearns jealously"? But He gives more grace. Therefore He says: "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble."
readings.ar: مَنْ هُوَ حَكِيمٌ وَعَالِمٌ بَيْنَكُمْ، فَلْيُرِ أَعْمَالَهُ بِٱلتَّصَرُّفِ ٱلْحَسَنِ فِي وَدَاعَةِ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ. وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ غَيْرَةٌ مُرَّةٌ وَتَحَزُّبٌ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ، فَلَا تَفْتَخِرُوا وَتَكْذِبُوا عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ. لَيْسَتْ هَذِهِ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ نَازِلَةً مِنْ فَوْقُ، بَلْ هِيَ أَرْضِيَّةٌ نَفْسَانِيَّةٌ شَيْطَانِيَّةٌ. لِأَنَّهُ حَيْثُ ٱلْغَيْرَةُ وَٱلتَّحَزُّبُ، هُنَاكَ ٱلتَّشْوِيشُ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ رَدِيءٍ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْحِكْمَةُ ٱلَّتِي مِنْ فَوْقُ فَهِيَ أَوَّلًا طَاهِرَةٌ، ثُمَّ مُسَالِمَةٌ، مُتَرَفِّقَةٌ، مُذْعِنَةٌ، مَمْلُوَّةٌ رَحْمَةً وَأَثْمَارًا صَالِحَةً، عَدِيمَةُ ٱلرَّيْبِ وَٱلرِّيَاءِ. وَثَمَرُ ٱلْبِرِّ يُزْرَعُ فِي ٱلسَّلَامِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْعَلُونَ ٱلسَّلَامَ. مِنْ أَيْنَ ٱلْحُرُوبُ وَٱلْخُصُومَاتُ بَيْنَكُمْ؟ أَلَيْسَتْ مِنْ هُنَا: مِنْ لَذَّاتِكُمُ ٱلْمُحَارِبَةِ فِي أَعْضَائِكُمْ؟ تَشْتَهُونَ وَلَسْتُمْ تَمْتَلِكُونَ. تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَحْسِدُونَ وَلَسْتُمْ تَقْدِرُونَ أَنْ تَنَالُوا. تُخَاصِمُونَ وَتُحَارِبُونَ وَلَسْتُمْ تَمْتَلِكُونَ، لِأَنَّكُمْ لَا تَطْلُبُونَ. تَطْلُبُونَ وَلَسْتُمْ تَأْخُذُونَ، لِأَنَّكُمْ تَطْلُبُونَ رَدِيًّا لِكَيْ تُنْفِقُوا فِي لَذَّاتِكُمْ. أَيُّهَا ٱلزُّنَاةُ وَٱلزَّوَانِي، أَمَا تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ مَحَبَّةَ ٱلْعَالَمِ عَدَاوَةٌ لِلهِ؟ فَمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُحِبًّا لِلْعَالَمِ، فَقَدْ صَارَ عَدُوًّا لِلهِ. أَمْ تَظُنُّونَ أَنَّ ٱلْكِتَابَ يَقُولُ بَاطِلًا: ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلَّذِي حَلَّ فِينَا يَشْتَاقُ إِلَى ٱلْحَسَدِ؟ وَلَكِنَّهُ يُعْطِي نِعْمَةً أَعْظَمَ. لِذَلِكَ يَقُولُ: «يُقَاوِمُ ٱللهُ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْمُتَوَاضِعُونَ فَيُعْطِيهِمْ نِعْمَةً».

readings.en: And after they had passed through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia. Now when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia. From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work which they had completed. Now when they had come and gathered the church together, they reported all that God had done with them, and that He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles. So they stayed there a long time with the disciples. And certain men came down from Judea and taught the brethren, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved." Therefore, when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and dispute with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them should go up to Jerusalem, to the apostles and elders, about this question. So, being sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, describing the conversion of the Gentiles; and they caused great joy to all the brethren.
readings.ar: وَلَمَّا ٱجْتَازَا فِي بِيسِيدِيَّةَ أَتَيَا إِلَى بَمْفِيلِيَّةَ. وَتَكَلَّمَا بِٱلْكَلِمَةِ فِي بَرْجَةَ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَا إِلَى أَتَّالِيَةَ. وَمِنْ هُنَاكَ سَافَرَا فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ إِلَى أَنْطَاكِيَةَ، حَيْثُ كَانَا قَدْ أُسْلِمَا إِلَى نِعْمَةِ ٱللهِ لِلْعَمَلِ ٱلَّذِي أَكْمَلَاهُ. وَلَمَّا حَضَرَا وَجَمَعَا ٱلْكَنِيسَةَ، أَخْبَرَا بِكُلِّ مَا صَنَعَ ٱللهُ مَعَهُمَا، وَأَنَّهُ فَتَحَ لِلْأُمَمِ بَابَ ٱلْإِيمَانِ. وَأَقَامَا هُنَاكَ زَمَانًا لَيْسَ بِقَلِيلٍ مَعَ ٱلتَّلَامِيذِ. وَٱنْحَدَرَ قَوْمٌ مِنَ ٱلْيَهُودِيَّةِ، وَجَعَلُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْإِخْوَةَ أَنَّهُ: «إِنْ لَمْ تَخْتَتِنُوا حَسَبَ عَادَةِ مُوسَى، لَا يُمْكِنُكُمْ أَنْ تَخْلُصُوا». فَلَمَّا حَصَلَ لِبُولُسَ وَبَرْنَابَا مُنَازَعَةٌ وَمُبَاحَثَةٌ لَيْسَتْ بِقَلِيلَةٍ مَعَهُمْ، رَتَّبُوا أَنْ يَصْعَدَ بُولُسُ وَبَرْنَابَا وَأُنَاسٌ آخَرُونَ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ وَٱلْمَشَايِخِ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ مِنْ أَجْلِ هَذِهِ ٱلْمَسْأَلَةِ. فَهَؤُلَاءِ بَعْدَ مَا شَيَّعَتْهُمُ ٱلْكَنِيسَةُ ٱجْتَازُوا فِي فِينِيقِيَةَ وَٱلسَّامِرَةِ يُخْبِرُونَهُمْ بِرُجُوعِ ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَكَانُوا يُسَبِّبُونَ سُرُورًا عَظِيمًا لِجَمِيعِ ٱلْإِخْوَةِ.

readings.en: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth! Sing out the honor of His name; Make His praise glorious.
readings.ar: اِهْتِفِي لِلهِ يَا كُلَّ ٱلْأَرْضِ! رَنِّمُوا بِمَجْدِ ٱسْمِهِ. ٱجْعَلُوا تَسْبِيحَهُ مُمَجَّدًا.

readings.en: So it was, as the multitude pressed about Him to hear the word of God, that He stood by the Lake of Gennesaret, and saw two boats standing by the lake; but the fishermen had gone from them and were washing their nets. Then He got into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat. When He had stopped speaking, He said to Simon, "Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch." But Simon answered and said to Him, "Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net." And when they had done this, they caught a great number of fish, and their net was breaking. So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink. When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!" For he and all who were with him were astonished at the catch of fish which they had taken; and so also were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch men." So when they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all and followed Him.
readings.ar: وَإِذْ كَانَ ٱلْجَمْعُ يَزْدَحِمُ عَلَيْهِ لِيَسْمَعَ كَلِمَةَ ٱللهِ، كَانَ وَاقِفًا عِنْدَ بُحَيْرَةِ جَنِّيسَارَتَ. فَرَأَى سَفِينَتَيْنِ وَاقِفَتَيْنِ عِنْدَ ٱلْبُحَيْرَةِ، وَٱلصَّيَّادُونَ قَدْ خَرَجُوا مِنْهُمَا وَغَسَلُوا ٱلشِّبَاكَ. فَدَخَلَ إِحْدَى ٱلسَّفِينَتَيْنِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ لِسِمْعَانَ، وَسَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُبْعِدَ قَلِيلًا عَنِ ٱلْبَرِّ. ثُمَّ جَلَسَ وَصَارَ يُعَلِّمُ ٱلْجُمُوعَ مِنَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ. وَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنَ ٱلْكَلَامِ قَالَ لِسِمْعَانَ: «ٱبْعُدْ إِلَى ٱلْعُمْقِ وَأَلْقُوا شِبَاكَكُمْ لِلصَّيْدِ». فَأَجَابَ سِمْعَانُ وَقَالَ لَهُ: «يَا مُعَلِّمُ، قَدْ تَعِبْنَا ٱللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ وَلَمْ نَأْخُذْ شَيْئًا. وَلَكِنْ عَلَى كَلِمَتِكَ أُلْقِي ٱلشَّبَكَةَ». وَلَمَّا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ أَمْسَكُوا سَمَكًا كَثِيرًا جِدًّا، فَصَارَتْ شَبَكَتُهُمْ تَتَخَرَّقُ. فَأَشَارُوا إِلَى شُرَكَائِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ ٱلْأُخْرَى أَنْ يَأْتُوا وَيُسَاعِدُوهُمْ. فَأَتَوْا وَمَلَأُوا ٱلسَّفِينَتَيْنِ حَتَّى أَخَذَتَا فِي ٱلْغَرَقِ. فَلَمَّا رَأَى سِمْعَانُ بُطْرُسُ ذَلِكَ خَرَّ عِنْدَ رُكْبَتَيْ يَسُوعَ قَائِلًا: «ٱخْرُجْ مِنْ سَفِينَتِي يَارَبُّ، لِأَنِّي رَجُلٌ خَاطِئٌ!». إِذِ ٱعْتَرَتْهُ وَجمِيعَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُ دَهْشَةٌ عَلَى صَيْدِ ٱلسَّمَكِ ٱلَّذِي أَخَذُوهُ. وَكَذَلِكَ أَيْضًا يَعْقُوبُ وَيُوحَنَّا ٱبْنَا زَبَدِي ٱللَّذَانِ كَانَا شَرِيكَيْ سِمْعَانَ. فَقَالَ يَسُوعُ لِسِمْعَانَ: «لَاتَخَفْ! مِنَ ٱلْآنَ تَكُونُ تَصْطَادُ ٱلنَّاسَ!». وَلَمَّا جَاءُوا بِٱلسَّفِينَتَيْنِ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ تَرَكُوا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَتَبِعُوهُ.

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (read at the evening prayer service) (Psalm 67:3–4): Here the psalmist prays that God may bless us and make His face shine on us, so that all nations may praise Him.
Vespers Gospel (Matthew 17:24–27): Here the tax collectors ask Peter whether his Teacher pays the temple tax, and the Lord sends Peter to find the coin in a fish's mouth.
Matins Psalm (read at the morning prayer service) (Psalm 63:6,3,4): Here David, in the wilderness, tells God, "My soul thirsts for You," and seeks Him early.
Matins Gospel (Mark 16:2–8): Here an angel in white tells the women at the tomb, "He is risen! He is not here," and sends them to tell the disciples and Peter.
Pauline Epistle (a letter written by St Paul) (2 Corinthians 4:5–15): Here St Paul tells the Christians in Corinth that we have this treasure in earthen vessels, so that the power may be of God.
Catholic Epistle (a letter to all churches by James, Peter, John or Jude) (James 3:13–18; 4:1–6): Here St James tells his readers that the wisdom from above is pure and peaceable, and that God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble.
Praxis (the reading from the Acts of the Apostles) (Acts 14:24–28; 15:1–3): Here Paul and Barnabas return to Antioch and report how God opened the door of faith to the Gentiles (people who are not Jewish), then go up to Jerusalem about circumcision (the Jewish sign of belonging to God's covenant).
Liturgy Psalm (read at the Liturgy, the service of Holy Communion) (Psalm 66:1,2): Here the psalmist calls all the earth to shout joyfully to God, and tells how He brought His people through fire and water.
Liturgy Gospel (Luke 5:1–11): Here the Lord Jesus teaches the crowds from Simon's boat, then gives a miraculous catch of fish and calls Peter, James and John to follow Him.

إنجيل العشية (متى 17: 24–27): هنا يسأل جباة الضريبة بطرس هل يوفي معلّمه الدرهمين، فيرسل الربّ بطرس ليجد الإستار في فم سمكة.

الكاثوليكون (رسالة من رسائل يعقوب أو بطرس أو يوحنا أو يهوذا) (يعقوب 3: 13–18؛ 4: 1–6): هنا يقول القدّيس يعقوب لقرّائه إنّ الحكمة التي من فوق طاهرة مسالمة، وإنّ الله يقاوم المستكبرين ويعطي المتواضعين نعمة.
الإبركسيس (قراءة من سفر أعمال الرسل) (اعمال 14: 24–28؛ 15: 1–3): هنا يرجع بولس وبرنابا إلى أنطاكية ويخبران كيف فتح الله باب الإيمان للأمم، ثمّ يصعدان إلى أورشليم بشأن الختان (علامة الانتماء إلى عهد الله عند اليهود).
مزمور القداس (مزامير 66: 1، 2): هنا يدعو صاحب المزمور الأرض كلّها إلى الهتاف لله، ويروي كيف أخرج شعبه عبر النار والماء.
إنجيل القداس (لوقا 5: 1–11): هنا يعلّم الربّ يسوع الجموع من سفينة سمعان، ثمّ يعطي صيدًا عجيبًا من السمك ويدعو بطرس ويعقوب ويوحنا ليتبعوه.

By the Lake of Gennesaret Jesus teaches from Simon's boat, then tells him, "Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch." Simon says, "Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net." They catch so many fish the nets break and two boats begin to sink. Peter falls at Jesus' knees: "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!" Jesus says, "Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch men." They leave everything and follow Him.

2 Corinthians 4: "we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord." "We have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us. We are hard-pressed on every side, yet not crushed." Obedience "at Your word" turns failure into fruit.
